scope: Checked ideal complete-message linear and best-bound endpoints; raw crossovers retain field/counter-fit and initialization premises

formulas.exact: q * exact_pairs_per_access (ring-ready); initialization allowance is zero
formulas.probe_ordinals: at level l: at most 1 + floor(q / carry_positions[l-1])
formulas.build_ordinals: at level l: at most 1 + floor(q / carry_positions[l-1]); includes seeded bases
formulas.routing_pairs: A_route + q * B_route (ring-ready), for the canonical full-run family inventory
formulas.combined_pairs: A_route + q * (B_route + exact_pairs_per_access); one normalization charge in NativeMatchLinearCoded
formulas.best_normalization: Widths 17-64: min(1, min(choose(initial_keys + q, 2), combined_pairs) / 2^128); width 16: zero; NativeMatchBestCoded compares identical failure/observation events
formulas.crossover: Eventual raw count crossover against choose(initial_keys + q, 2); initialized rows use full-capacity initialization, empty-start rows use zero
formulas.crossover_saturation: crossover_before_probability_saturation tests only the normalization allowance < 1; it does not certify total error < 1 or field/counter fit at that horizon
formulas.capacity_matching: At base horizon 2^32: exposureBudget(member) + weight(member,start)/2^128; exact rational allocation from NativeMatchInventory.Fits, using initialized capacity exposures for both starts
formulas.matching: weight = 64^4 * sMin + 2^32 * denseBuckets * 14 * 8^2; includes rebuild and dense VP2 matching
formulas.remaining_margin: 2^-64 - capacity_initialized_exposure_budget - matching_probability_budget; nonnegative residual of the existing certified allocation, not an additional failure bound or a normalization absorption claim
formulas.chunk_scaling: For h chunks multiply the capacity, matching, target and residual by h; the checked endpoint remains h * 2^-64 + normalization
